summary_brief: 今日(10-09)延续9月下旬以来"Agent安全治理+基础设施成熟+编排生产级"主线，无方向性转折，重心进一步细化到上下文生命周期治理与推理成本优化。延续层面：①安全加固全面铺开（沙箱凭据掩码、trace凭据剥离、Next.js SSRF高危修复、供应链完整性），直接承接10-01~10-07及3月中以来的安全共识；②OpenAI Decisions API被生态快速采纳（promptfoo支持、vercel/ai多模态decisions输入），延续10-07"能力原语标准化"；③vercel/ai批量发版220子包（持久化WebSocket传输、embedding顶层dimensions）、评测与可观测性深化（Phoenix/Promptfoo/Playwright），延续SDK成熟与工具链infra化。真正的新增推进点在两点：其一，多智能体上下文治理成为攻坚焦点——Codex、Agno、Deepagents、ruflo同时推进对话压缩、可检索归档、子代理状态保留与**上下文来源逐条追踪**（ContentItemMetadata区分用户/开发者指令/AGENTS.md/技能来源），为提示注入防御与指令优先级治理提供工程地基，这是10-07"可追溯性"向"可治理性"的纵深延伸；其二，推理成本研究工程化——Codex引入experimentalPredictionMode的预测分支复用以最大化prompt-cache命中，配合性能精细化调优（opencode冷启动提速5倍、promptfoo索引去重提速202倍）。科研端延续评测方法论深化（HyDE检索变换、OpenHands跨模型评估、Oracle原生向量后端）。整体定性：从安全"堵漏"进阶到编排"可治理"，今日再深化为"上下文/来源的精细化治理与成本优化"，生产级成熟阶段继续推进，无显著新爆发。

engineering_signals.title: 多智能体编排中的上下文生命周期治理成为焦点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个框架（Codex、Agno、Deepagents、ruflo）同时聚焦于长会话上下文管理：对话压缩、可检索归档、子代理状态保留、上下文来源逐条追踪。这标志着多智能体系统正从'能跑'走向'可靠地管理超长复杂度对话'，上下文预算、来源归因、状态持久化成为核心工程能力。

engineering_signals.title: 多智能体外部框架互操作性持续扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 新增 CodexAgent 外部代理适配器，将 OpenAI Codex 本地代理循环完整翻译为通用 run 事件流；openai/ai SDK 则新增 OpenAI decisions API 的多模态支持。多框架间通过标准协议与适配器互相打通，AgentOS 生态的多框架协作正在成为现实。

engineering_signals.title: 代理沙盒与凭据安全成为跨项目安全加固主旋律
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex、openai-agents-python、ruflo、Playwright、pipelinefoo 等多个项目在同一天密集推出沙箱凭据掩码、trace 凭据剥离、macOS 沙箱阻断 Launch Services、网络策略域匹配器强化等安全措施。代理运行环境正从'功能优先'转向系统性安全加固，防止凭据泄露与沙箱逃逸。

engineering_signals.title: 代理运行时性能优化从冷启动到工具调用全面提速
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: opencode 冷启动提速 5 倍、codex 只读工具并行执行、promptfoo 索引去重提速 202 倍、cline SSH 登录频率降 12 倍。代理系统的性能瓶颈正从模型推理转向运行时基础设施（启动、工具调度、IO、数据去重），标志代理工程进入精细化调优阶段。

engineering_signals.title: AI SDK 生态向多模态与实时通信能力演进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 批量发版引入顶层 embedding dimensions、持久化 WebSocket 聊天传输、多模态 decisions 输入、HeyGen 视频生成供应商；同时 OpenAI decisions API 在 langchain 和 Promptfoo 中获得支持。这一波集中在多模态输入、实时流式通信、决策类 API 的标准化，标志 AI 开发框架在应用层能力上的集体升级。

engineering_signals.title: 单服务器隔离与多副本一致性成为分布式代理架构关键命题
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: deer-flow 在技能缓存跨网关失效、登录锁定跨副本计数、MCP 发现单服务器隔离、检索索引 Pod 本地化上做出系统性改进；openclaw 将共享写入迁移到 worker 线程、会议流式导出优化。分布式多副本代理架构下的一致性与故障隔离问题正被系统性解决。

engineering_signals.title: 评测与可观测性工具深化安全模式与诊断能力
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Promptfoo 新增评测安全模式禁用内联 JS、暴露截断完成状态，Playwright 改进无障碍可见性判定与仅打印失败报告，Phoenix 新增 trace 并排对比与实验表格相对基线增量。LLM 评测与可观测性工具正从基础指标采集走向安全的代码执行环境与更细粒度的诊断能力。

research_signals.title: 预测分支复用与 prompt-cache 优化的推理成本探索
research_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 引入 experimentalPredictionMode 的分支机制，通过继承父线程有效上下文和请求配置来最大化 prompt-cache 复用；Agno 的对话压缩与可检索归档让超长会话保持在上下文窗口内。这代表着通过上下文复用和缓存命中降低推理成本的研究方向正在工程化落地。

research_signals.title: 跨模型评测覆盖与 Agent 验证框架能力补齐
research_signals.why_it_matters: OpenHands 将 mock-LLM 端到端测试驱动到 DeepSeek 并映射能力差距，同时补齐 verify-openhands 验证框架短板。配合 Promptfoo 对 Decisions API 的支持与相对基线增量展示，Agent 评测正从单一模型扩展到跨模型、跨场景的系统化评估。

research_signals.title: HyDE 检索变换与向量存储多后端扩展推动 RAG 前沿
research_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 新增 HyDE 假设文档检索策略提升向量检索命中率，微软 agent-framework 新增 Oracle 原生向量存储连接器，vercel/ai 将 embedding dimensions 提升为顶层配置。RAG 检索策略与向量后端生态同步演进，反映知识检索在 Agent 系统中的重要性与日俱增。

research_signals.title: 上下文来源归因与可观测性支撑 Agent 指令治理研究
research_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 通过 ContentItemMetadata 区分用户输入、开发者指令、AGENTS.md、技能等上下文来源并贯穿提示词组装；Phoenix 强化 trace 追踪与并排对比。对上下文来源的逐条追踪为 Agent 审计、指令优先级治理与提示注入防御提供了工程地基。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 网关与协议增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Code 在单次发布中密集交付了网关模型路由、超时控制、审计追踪、终端状态协议（OSC 7501）等企业级能力，并修复了 MCP 连接、沙箱、插件系统等大量稳定性问题，标志着其从个人工具向企业级 AI 开发平台的快速演进。

release_signals.title: Agno 引入对话压缩与外部代理适配
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agno 框架新增了可搜索的对话压缩机制，解决了长会话上下文管理难题；同时通过 CodexAgent 适配器，实现了对 OpenAI Codex 等外部代理的无缝集成，增强了其作为多代理编排框架的通用性和生态连接能力。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 增强 TUI 与沙箱安全
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 在 TUI 中新增了任务固定、转录复制、可点击链接等交互改进，并强化了 Linux 沙箱的启动安全性和 Windows 平台兼容性，同时发布了签名安装器，提升了开发体验和供应链安全。

release_signals.title: 微软 Agent Framework 扩展向量存储与推理选项
release_signals.why_it_matters: 微软的 Agent Framework 新增了 Oracle 原生向量存储连接器，并为 OpenAI 代理添加了最大推理努力选项，同时更新了 Anthropic 和 GitHub Copilot SDK，持续扩展其多平台 AI 代理开发框架的能力边界。

release_signals.title: Cline 多端同步更新并修复关键问题
release_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 桌面端、CLI 和 SDK 同步更新，修复了 SSH 远程连接、后台服务崩溃等关键问题，并刷新了模型目录，默认模型向 Claude Haiku 5.5 迁移，提升了跨平台开发体验的稳定性和模型选择的经济性。

release_signals.title: AutoGPT 平台化功能显著增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: AutoGPT 平台新增了 Discord/Slack/Teams 等渠道的原生审批卡片、GitHub 流量分析、Hacker News 搜索等大量新模块，并加强了用户通知、邮件验证和数据分析，正从实验性项目向功能丰富的自动化平台演进。

release_signals.title: Phoenix 强化 MCP 与沙箱能力
release_signals.why_it_matters: Arize Phoenix 新增了 GraphQL 查询工具和 Docker 沙箱提供者，并优化了 PXI 的 MCP 代码模式，进一步巩固了其作为 LLM 可观测性和评估平台的地位。

release_signals.title: Promptfoo 支持 OpenAI Decisions 与成本记录
release_signals.why_it_matters: Promptfoo 新增了对 OpenAI Decisions API 的支持，并允许在无阈值情况下记录成本，同时修复了多项断言和 RedTeam 相关问题，增强了其作为 LLM 评测和红队工具的功能完整性。

release_signals.title: Goose 引入 HTML 会话导出与模式引导
release_signals.why_it_matters: Goose 新增了带交互式查看器的 HTML 会话导出功能，并在首次配置时引导用户选择模式，同时修复了 Claude 自适应思考和 Copilot 令牌刷新等问题，提升了可用性和会话管理能力。

release_signals.title: Vercel SDK 引入 Sandbox Drive 功能
release_signals.why_it_matters: Vercel TypeScript SDK 新增了 Sandbox Drive 的获取、列表、创建和分叉等操作，并移除了多个 API 的 401 错误定义（Breaking Change），反映了 Vercel 平台对沙盒化开发环境的持续投入。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 220 个子包（5 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: 本批发版并非纯版本同步，而包含多项实质变更：核心 ai 包新增 embedding 顶层 dimensions 设置与持久化 WebSocket 聊天传输，实验性决策状态被重构为支持有序 text/file/JSON parts；同时 @ai-sdk/mcp 对实验性 MCP 事件适配器 API 做出破坏性变更（须实现 createAdapter）。除上述核心及少量带 fix/feat 的包外，其余绝大多数子包仅为沿依赖链的例行 patch 传递升级，未引入自身变更。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/mcp@2.0.73
release_signals.why_it_matters: 对实验性 MCP 事件适配器 API 做出破坏性变更，要求实现新的同步 createAdapter 方法，影响订阅操作接口使用方式

release_signals.title: vercel/ai ai@7.0.135
release_signals.why_it_matters: 核心包新增持久化 WebSocket 聊天传输这一重要新能力，并新增顶层嵌入 dimensions 设置及多项流式修复

release_signals.title: vercel/ai ai@7.0.133
release_signals.why_it_matters: 核心包将实验性决策状态重构为支持有序 text/file/JSON parts 并加入图片输入，属于新增能力

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/provider@4.0.26
release_signals.why_it_matters: 作为底层基础包新增 embedding 顶层 dimensions 设置，是全批 provider 适配的根基

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/workflow@2.0.66
release_signals.why_it_matters: 将 Workflow SDK 支持从实验性升级到稳定的 5.1.0 正式版本

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- 7b5497c: Fix streaming output timeouts: stop `chunkMs` and `firstChunkMs` when the model response ends, so long-running local tools do not trigger model output timeouts. Give each retry fresh output timeout budgets. `stepMs` continues to cover the complete step, including local tools.
- Updated dependencies [e280aa1]
  - @ai-sdk/gateway@4.0.110

ai@7.0.135 新增持久化 WebSocket 聊天传输（相关性流式、背压、取消、序列续传）
ai@7.0.133 及 typesafe-ai/gateway/openai/otel 等将实验性决策状态重构为有序 text/file/JSON parts，并支持图片输入
@ai-sdk/mcp@2.0.73 对实验性 MCP 事件适配器做出破坏性变更（须实现 createAdapter）

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- b5b0416: Give experimental managed event adapters a synchronous `createAdapter({ transport })` method that receives the configured MCP transport type and URL and returns bound subscription operations. Applications no longer need to configure the endpoint twice.

  **Breaking change to the experimental API:** the configured integration is now `Experimental_MCPEventAdapter` and must implement `createAdapter`. The former `Experimental_MCPEventsAdapter` subscription operations interface is renamed to `Experimental_MCPEventOperations`. Update imports and operation type annotations, and wrap existing operations with `{ createAdapter: () => operations }` instead of passing them directly to `experimental_events.adapter`.

  `createAdapter` must synchronously return an object implementing `subscribe`, `getSubscription`, `listSubscriptions`, and `unsubscribe`. Missing or non-callable operations, nullish results, and Promise/thenable results now reject `createMCPClient` with `MCPClientError` before the transport starts.

  The adapter receives a fresh `transport: { type: 'http' | 'sse', url: string }` description for built-in transport configurations or `transport: { type: 'custom' }` for custom instances. Credentials, callbacks, and live transport methods are not forwarded.

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through
- Added Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501) support: terminals that implement it can show whether Claude Code is working, waiting on you, or done
- Added quoted text to the `/copy` picker, so a drafted message copies without its `>` markers
- Added a warning to `claude plugin install`, `enable`, `disable` and `marketplace add` when the settings file they write to does not load
- Added a line on stderr, when it is a terminal, that says what a `claude -p` run is waiting for when it stays open after its last turn
- Added support for `timeouts.upstream_ttfb_ms` on the Claude apps gateway's Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other cloud upstreams: a value you set now limits how long a stream may take to start there, after which it fails over or gets a 502
- Added a "Backgrounding cancelled" message when you stop the turn while `←` is waiting for the current tool to finish
- Added an optional `models` list to every Claude apps gateway upstream: only the listed models are sent there, on failover too, and one `*` in an entry is a wildcard
- Added support for `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"` and `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in your own user settings on machines with no managed settings, so `/login` opens on that Claude apps gateway
- Added advice to `claude plugin validate` when a plugin's README has no install line: it prints the line to paste and never changes the exit code, even with `--strict`
- Added `upstream_request_id` to the Claude apps gateway's `inference` audit event: the request ID from Amazon Bedrock, the Anthropic API or another upstream, for support cases
- Added `$.ui.notify` for mods: raises a native notification through your own notification setting and says which channel sent it
- Added children to a mod's `Button`: strings and `Text`, so a row of a list is one pressable with a chip or a dim detail inside
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS` to limit how long unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) waits out 429 and 529 errors
- Added a `request-id` header to the Claude apps gateway's successful inference responses, so `request_id` in Claude Code telemetry matches the gateway's audit log
- Fixed every request failing on a `[1m]` model when a gateway, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry refuses the context-1m beta; Claude Code now resends without it
- Fixed `claude -p` text output dropping earlier responses when background work started another turn; each turn's response now prints when the turn ends
- Fixed remote MCP servers in headless and SDK sessions staying disconnected after an outage longer than 15 seconds, or reconnecting in a tight loop to a server that drops each connection right after it connects; repeated drops now back off, up to 30s
- Fixed remote MCP connections being dropped when a server's error reply happened to contain a network error name
- Fixed MCP servers that repeat a pagination cursor being asked for the same page up to 20 times at every connect
- Fixed CSS, JavaScript and XML files returned by MCP tools being saved as .bin, which the Read tool refuses; font and icon files now get their own extension too
- Fixed Bash tool calls failing when the model passes `command_description` instead of `description`
- Fixed Claude in Chrome not applying a site deny rule written with port 80 (`host:80`) to plain `http://` pages on that host
- Fixed `/plugin`'s Errors tab removing a marketplace that failed to load, and uninstalling its plugins, on Enter without asking first
- Fixed `claude plugin marketplace add` reporting success for a marketplace whose name no plugin can be installed under; such an add is now refused
- Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` moving a subagent to the background while an edit or shell command waited behind it, which started that call before the subagent finished
- Fixed PushNotification saying a push was not sent in `claude remote-control` sessions right after a phone message, without the `/config` toggle, or when started from inside Claude Code
- Fixed files sent from remote sessions being refused as "could not be vouched for" when more than 256 were sent at once
- Fixed a rare failure to load managed settings at startup right after a login refresh
- Fixed `/tui` exiting without a message, or with a raw system error, when Claude Code could not be started again
- Fixed a link address shown as text being hidden by a colour or conceal style a reply left on, including where it wraps in a table or a question preview
- Fixed Fable models listed in `availableModels` not appearing in the `/model` picker for sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway; such a model now shows its built-in row in place of a `modelPicker` row added for the same model
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway's admin spend view showing a developer's old groups and group cap after their session stopped carrying groups
- Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` hiding the Claude apps gateway spend limit in `/usage` and the status line. The spend limit request goes to the gateway the session is signed in to
- Fixed subagents in their own linked worktree being shown the parent session's git branch, status and recent commits
- Fixed Claude stopping at the end of the current tool when text typed in the prompt cancelled backgrounding with `←`; Claude now keeps working in the foreground
- Fixed `--tools` and `--restricted` not applying to built-in tools that register after launch, and deprecated tool names reaching tools outside the caller's tool set
- Fixed an interrupt not ending the turn until a timeout while Claude waited for an MCP server's resource list
- Fixed a mod's hook being handed a deeply nested tool input cut short with no error, so a guard could pass content it never saw
- Fixed Esc not stopping a self-paced `/loop` that was moved to the background with `←`; cancelling a pending wakeup now shows a notice
- Fixed commands and hooks in background sessions inheriting `FORCE_COLOR=3`, which put color escape codes into the output Claude reads
- Fixed `claude agents` starting a new background service as it exited when both were stopped with a session open (for example at a reboot), which could delay shutdown and restart an interrupted session
- Fixed a custom agent named `worker` being shown as "Agent" in auto-mode denial notices and in the activity lists of task detail views
- Fixed Bash permission checks for for-loops over glob patterns, improving permission-check accuracy
- Fixed forked skills invoked from Workflow subagents delivering their results to the main conversation instead of the invoking agent
- Fixed in-process agent teammates failing their first SendMessage call until they loaded the tool through tool search
- Fixed Claude being told on resume that an unfinished background workflow may have been stopped by `TaskStop`, which can never be the cause
- Fixed Claude not being told when you stop a long-running MCP tool call from the tasks panel or a connected client
- Fixed a background session's `/loop` stopping without notice when its next wakeup came due while the session's process was down; the session now says so and Claude is told
- Fixed raw terminal hyperlink bytes in a reply or a teammate's message being drawn as a clickable link with a hidden address
- Fixed plugin marketplaces whose repository has large git submodules failing to add or refresh: only the submodules that hold plugin files are now fetched
- Fixed the `/advisor` dialog showing a checkmark on a saved advisor model that is no longer available; it now opens on "No advisor"
- Fixed the notification for an MCP tool call that moved to the background showing a shortened task id
- Fixed vim mode's `~` moving the cursor past the last character of a line, so `x` after it did nothing, and `3~` running on into the next line
- Fixed the cursor landing one character too far after pasting accented text copied from macOS (such as a file name) into the middle of the prompt
- Fixed the terminal freezing, with ctrl+c ignored, when a response ran to tens of thousands of lines
- Fixed calls a mod makes while it reloads during a plugin hooks worker restart getting past another mod's guard hook that has a `.catch`; such calls are now refused
- Fixed plugins whose hooks module nests code thousands of levels deep failing to load or validate with a bare stack-overflow message
- Fixed `claude plugin test` passing a `session.append` hook that removes tool call, tool result or thinking blocks that a real session keeps
- Fixed Claude not being told it can resume background subagents with SendMessage after a session was killed and resumed a second time
- Fixed a file being treated as already read after a Bash command such as `cat` ran without printing it
- Fixed plugin options named `constructor` or `prototype` always reading as their default and never reloading the plugin when edited
- Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made while `/reload-plugins` or session start was reading the mod's files
- Fixed the mod hot-reloading question being asked again every turn for the whole session when it is approved without picking an answer
- Fixed `/model`, `/fast` and `/output-style` saving their setting without asking a plugin's `config.set` hook
- Fixed bold text being drawn faint in piped output when it directly follows dim text
- Fixed replies whose quotes nest deeper every few lines freezing the terminal for seconds and using gigabytes of memory
- Fixed a mod's hot reload missing a save made within a few milliseconds of its last reload, which left the mod on its old version until the next save
- Fixed `claude mcp serve` background Bash results not naming the output file, and its tool description promising a notification that never arrives
- Fixed an async SessionStart hook's unchanged context being added to the conversation again on every resume
- Fixed variables a SessionStart hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool after an in-app `/resume` or `/branch`
- Fixed a skill's `allowed-tools` and `effort` being dropped when the Skill tool finished before the response stream ended, which denied the skill's Bash commands in `-p` runs
- Fixed a tampered cache of server-managed settings making a person's own plugin count as organization-managed on machines whose managed settings list or enable plugins
- Fixed Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3.x Sonnet sessions being offered tool search, which those models reject, where feature flags are unavailable
- Fixed generated type files being written into a `--plugin-dir` plugin's folder in `-p` and SDK sessions; they are now written only where a mod is being developed
- Fixed text with tabs or bidirectional control characters losing its end at the edge of the screen or drawing over nearby rows
- Fixed `/model` saying a Max effort pick was saved as your default for new sessions; Max applies to the current session only
- Fixed an async hook's JSON output being ignored when it is printed over several lines
- Fixed the Read tool rejecting calls with an empty `pages` parameter instead of treating it as omitted
- Fixed project-scope plugins not loading in VS Code on Windows due to drive-letter casing (anthropics/claude-code#74612)
- Fixed `plugin install` and `uninstall` at project or local scope on Windows missing the install record, or adding a second one, when only the drive letter's case differs
- Fixed a queued message being lost when pulled back into the prompt with `↑` or `Esc` just after `←`: prompt history now keeps it
- Fixed mod hot-reloading turning off for the whole session when an SDK host closed its enable question before anyone answered; the question is now asked up to three times
- Fixed a prompt that a mod's `prompt.submit` hook rewrote or dropped still being saved as typed to prompt history and to the transcript's queued-prompt records
- Fixed non-interactive sessions telling you about MCP servers that need authentication when your request doesn't use them
- Fixed the `claude_code.auth` OpenTelemetry login event not being emitted on Claude apps gateway sign-in. The event is exported when OpenTelemetry is configured on the machine or the session is already signed in to the gateway
- Fixed a plugin that adds very large interfaces getting another plugin unloaded when the plugin hooks worker stalls
- Fixed Edit treating a file as fully read when its contents changed without its modification time advancing
- Fixed short command output with Windows line endings (CRLF) being drawn on a single line
- Fixed a stopped scheduled task coming back on resume after a rewind, and a scheduled task being lost on resume after Esc or a rewind following a compaction
- Fixed the terminal freezing for seconds or minutes while syntax highlighting code with very long lines, long runs of blank lines, or unclosed strings and heredocs
- Fixed temporary files left under `~/.claude/seed-admin` by an interrupted `/ultrareview` upload never being removed by the retention cleanup
- Fixed Desktop and SDK sessions refusing to switch back to auto mode until restart after `disableAutoMode` was removed from settings
- Fixed claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" in long-running sessions after another session synced a plugin update
- Fixed the prompt sent after a `/rewind` being lost, and the removed turns coming back, when the session was moved to the background or resumed after being killed
- Fixed cloud sessions hanging when a mod's `session.receive` hook asked for permission before passing a message on
- Fixed macOS background sessions that restart together after an update sometimes running outside the stable app wrapper, so folder-access prompts could reappear
- Fixed an MCP sign-in or reconnect that finishes late in headless and SDK sessions relisting a server set with `setMcpServers()` as your own
- Fixed changing the auto-update channel in `/config` saving before a plugin's `config.set` hook was asked
- macOS: Fixed a file count at session start that could reach other apps' data and raise the "access data from other apps" prompt when a session starts in the home folder or above it
- Improved token counts behind a Claude apps gateway on Amazon Bedrock, which `/context` and large file reads use: the gateway now gets them from AWS's CountTokens API instead of a one-token model request. Grant `bedrock:CountTokens` to use it
- Improved the Claude apps gateway to log a warning every 30 seconds while its PostgreSQL database is read-only, saying what fails and how to recover
- Improved the status shown in Remote Control, claude.ai and the desktop app for a session waiting on a permission prompt to name an MCP tool by its server and readable name instead of its `mcp__server__tool` identifier
- Improved background requests behind a Claude apps gateway to use Haiku 4.5 instead of the session's model, falling back to the session's model where the gateway does not serve Haiku 4.5
- Improved how the Claude apps gateway handles models not listed under `models:` in Amazon Bedrock regions outside AWS's US geography. AWS always refused those requests; the gateway now tries the model in your own region, and a refusal names the model to add
- Improved headless `rate_limit_event` usage-limit warnings to say whether the account has extra usage turned on
- Improved the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill: it no longer tells a session with no terminal to run terminal commands, and explains sharing a mod only when asked
- Improved Grep input handling: a search sent with grep's `-l`, `-c` or `-r` flag now runs instead of failing the call
- Improved `claude plugin validate` and plugin loading: when a hooks module is refused over a rebound top-level `var`, the error now names the line that rebinds it, the cause, and a fix
- Improved the Workflow tool's `scriptPath` refusal: it now says to pass the script inline via `script`, the route that works in sessions without a Read tool
- Improved what Claude is told when a large file it sends fails to upload with no reason given, so it reports the failure instead of shrinking the file
- Changed MCP tool descriptions the model loads through tool search to be cut at 16,384 characters instead of 2,048
- Changed subagents to preload at most 32 skills from the `skills` field, each once; a subagent with the Skill tool can still invoke the rest
- Changed Ctrl+C at the idle prompt of an attached background session to leave a pending `/loop` wakeup alone, so pressing it twice detaches and the loop keeps running; press Esc to stop it
- Changed `claude agents` stopped with its background service (macOS, or Linux without the service installed): running sessions now stop in about a minute unless it is run again, and a notice says so
- Changed claude.ai connectors to negotiate MCP protocol version 2026-07-28 by default on installs that fetch no flags; `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy` opts out
- Changed Artifact pages with no background of their own to show on white instead of off-white
- Changed what Claude and you read when a mod denies a tool call after the tool ran: it now says the tool ran and a plugin withheld its result
- Changed tab stops to count from where a text starts instead of from the screen's left edge: an answer indented by 2 has its first stop 8 cells in, where it was 6
- Changed the Artifact tool's permission prompts with telemetry disabled to the same five questions other installs get, instead of asking before each read of someone else's artifact and each data edit
- Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs in installs with telemetry disabled to publish new private artifacts, and update your own, without asking, as in other installs
- Changed toasts from your organization's mods to show ahead of other mods' toasts instead of waiting behind them
- Changed the Claude apps gateway to start with a warning and serve a `desktop` policy key its bundled Claude Desktop schema doesn't know, so new Desktop settings need no gateway upgrade
- Changed WebSocket (`ws`) MCP servers: a message over 16 MiB is no longer parsed and closes the connection, the limit the other transports already have
- [VSCode] Added a chat row for files Claude sends you: click a file's name to open it in the editor; Claude's caption shows underneath, and the row stays visible in Focus view
- [VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" and Rewind's conversation restore failing with "Message not found in session" after a background agent's activity or one of the panel's own status lines
- [VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+Shift+Tab, Cmd+Shift+Tab and Alt+Shift+Tab in the chat input also switching the permission mode, and Ctrl+Tab accepting the suggested prompt
- [VSCode] Fixed keyboard focus bouncing between two Claude views visible at once, which could send typed text to the wrong conversation
- Self-hosted runner: Changed the runner to stop passing `CCR_AUTO_MODE_ALLOW`, `CCR_AUTO_MODE_ENVIRONMENT` and `CCR_AUTO_MODE_SOFT_DENY` into a session's environment
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed git fetches being cut off while the git server was still reporting progress on a large repository; `CLAUDE_RUNNER_FETCH_SERVER_PROGRESS_CAP_MS` tunes or turns off the wait
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed a message sent right after unarchiving a cloud session sometimes getting no reply because no container could start for it
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed some older routines starting their runs without ever giving Claude their saved prompt; those routines now run their prompt again
- [Cloud sessions] Improved how quickly a cloud session catches up after its connection drops: activity you missed now appears all at once instead of row by row
- [Cloud sessions] Improved the setup script box in the cloud environment form: it starts taller, grows with your script, and can be resized by dragging
- [Claude Tag] Changed the settings confirmation cards Claude posts in a Slack channel to stay open for 30 minutes instead of 10
- [Claude Tag] Changed Claude's notice that a channel shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces uses organization defaults to post only when someone mentions Claude, at most once a month
- [Claude Tag] Fixed channel links and @-mentions in a forked thread's "Continued from" card showing as raw Slack codes
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Slack's Working status spinning on under a thread after `@Claude !restart` had already confirmed the restart
- [Claude Tag] Fixed another app's or bot's @Claude going unanswered in a busy channel where Claude had stopped reading untagged messages
- [Claude Tag] Added a confirmation in Claude Tag admin settings before adding a channel manager moves that member to Custom roles, which can remove their other access
- [Code Review] Fixed Code Review re-reviews saying no issues were found while earlier findings were still open; the comment now says how many remain open
- [Code Review] Fixed Code Review still skipping a large CLAUDE.md's rules when the pull request edits that file
- Fixed web searches and `agent` hook evaluations taking much longer at `xhigh` and `max` effort

key_changes: 新增命令和HTTP钩子的 `onFailure: "block"` 支持，钩子启动失败、超时或异常退出时可阻止操作继续执行

releases.author: ashwin-ant
releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `overageEnabled` to `SDKRateLimitInfo`: on usage-limit warnings, whether the account has extra usage turned on
- Fixed an MCP server added with `mcp_set_servers` sometimes keeping an outdated tool list when another server in the same request connected later
- Fixed assistant text blocks losing their `citations` in streamed responses
- Fixed Claude being told "disabled by the user" about an in-process MCP server that was switched off with `toggleMcpServer()`
- Fixed `rate_limit_event` with status `allowed_warning` omitting `overageStatus`, `overageResetsAt` and `overageDisabledReason`, which `allowed` and `rejected` events already carry
- Changed MCP tool descriptions the model loads through tool search, including those from in-process SDK servers, to be cut at 16,384 characters instead of 2,048
- Changed a permission answer whose `updatedPermissions` holds over 4,096 updates, rules and directories to count as a denial
- Changed `tool_result_meta[].non_execution_kind` to be absent when a mod withheld the result of a tool that ran without error; it was `permission-rule`
- Changed `pasted_content` on user messages to be ignored when it holds over 1,000 entries and blocks in all
- Changed how the SDK passes option values to Claude Code: the values of its named options are now sent in the same argument as their flag (`--flag=value`)
- Changed `tool_use_result` for MCP Apps tools: `structuredContent` or `_meta` over 8,388,608 JSON characters is left off, and `_meta.ui` with no `ui://` resource no longer lifts the ordinary caps
- Changed `tool_use_result` for MCP tools: when a long result is saved to a file, or cut because it could not be, the text kept past 500,000 characters is dropped, with a note of how much
- Changed `tool_use_result` for MCP tools: a result `_meta` over 1,048,576 JSON characters is left off, except for SDK-server tools; so is text blocks' `_meta` that totals over 65,536
- Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.295

## Update

```sh
npm install @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.295
# or
yarn add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.295
# or
pnpm add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.295
# or
bun add @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.295
```

key_changes: 新增 `overageEnabled` 字段到 `SDKRateLimitInfo`，用于标识账户是否开启了额外用量
修复多个 MCP 相关问题：工具列表过期、流式响应中 citations 丢失、进程内 MCP 服务器被错误告知"已禁用"等问题
将 MCP 工具描述的最大截断长度从 2,048 字符提升至 16,384 字符
调整了多项结果大小限制策略：工具结果 `_meta` 超限处理、`pasted_content` 超过 1,000 条时忽略等
优化 SDK 传参方式，命名选项值改为 `--flag=value` 形式传递
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本主要包含多项修复和改进，重点修复了 MCP 服务器工具列表不同步、流式响应中 citations 丢失等若干 bug，并在 `rate_limit_info` 中新增了 `overageEnabled` 字段以提供更完整的用量信息。此外，SDK 对各类结果数据大小限制策略进行了多项调整，并优化了传参方式，整体行为与 Claude Code v2.1.295 保持对齐。

- Commit message generation and tasks with reasoning off no longer fail with a 400 error on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Fable 5 or Claude Opus 5.5

- `cline dashboard` is now `cline hub dashboard`. The old command still works as a hidden alias
- A bare `cline hub` prints its subcommands
- `cline doctor log` opens the file set by `CLINE_LOG_PATH` when that variable is set
- `cline --help` is corrected: `--retries` shows its real default of 3 (it said 6), and `--thinking` explains that it falls back to the level picked in `/model`
- A bare `--retries` with no count is now rejected with an error instead of crashing
- Options that were accepted but never did anything are removed and now fail with "unknown option": `cline history --page`, and `cline schedule create`/`update` `--autonomous`, `--no-autonomous`, `--idle-timeout`, `--poll-interval` and `--delivery-channel`. Remove them from scripts. Existing schedules saved with them still load
- `cline schedule create`, `update` and `import` reject a delivery that could never be posted, such as `--delivery-adapter` without `--delivery-thread` or an adapter that isn't a known connector. releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- The AI SDK moves together to one release line: `ai` 7.0.120 and every `@ai-sdk/*` package on `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.50 (previously `ai` 7.0.79 with packages bumped one by one). Turning reasoning off no longer sends `reasoning.effort: "none"` to OpenAI models that can't turn it off, such as GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol (GPT-6 Astra answered with a 400, for example from commit message generation); GPT-5.x and GPT-6 Sol/Luna still get `"none"`. Turning reasoning off also no longer sends `thinking: {type: "disabled"}` to Claude models that can't turn thinking off, such as Claude Fable 5 and Opus 5.5 (they answered with `"thinking.type.disabled" is not supported for this model`); other Claude models still get `disabled`
- Stdio MCP clients handle EPIPE when a server exits before reading all of its input. Previously that raised an uncaught exception on the host process. The SAP AI Core provider also no longer installs winston's process-wide `uncaughtException` handler, which called `process.exit(1)` three seconds after any uncaught error
- The legacy provider-settings migration no longer adds an empty `sapaicore` entry to `providers.json`. It used to do this for every migrated user, because the extension writes `sapAiCoreUseOrchestrationMode` as a default
- `@cline/core` exports `parseMcpHeaders`, used by the CLI's `mcp add` wizard to keep `--header` values
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds Claude Haiku 5.5. Default models change for Google Vertex AI (Claude Sonnet 5.5 → Claude Haiku 5.5), Cortecs, DevPass (LLM Gateway), Eden AI, GitHub Copilot, LLM Gateway, NanoGPT, OpenCode Go, Requesty, and Vivgrid (most now Claude Haiku 5.5)

releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Conversation Compaction**: `Agent(compaction=True)` keeps long sessions inside the context window by folding older turns into a summary. Stored messages are never rewritten: a `CompactionRecord` in the new `agno_compactions` table drives a derived model payload, so removing the record restores the full conversation. Tune with `Compaction(model=..., compact_at_tokens=..., uncompacted_runs=...)`, fold on demand with `agent.compact()` / `acompact()`, and inspect `run.compaction`. With `searchable=True` the agent gets a `search_compacted_history` tool, a regex grep over the archived transcript. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/02_agents/03_context_management/compaction/compaction.py). (#9873)
- **Codex External Agent**: Added `CodexAgent`, an adapter for OpenAI Codex built on the `openai-codex` SDK, alongside the Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, DSPy and Antigravity adapters. Codex runs its own agent loop; the adapter translates its notifications into Agno run and tool-call events, maps each Agno session to one Codex thread (persisted when a `db` is set), and exposes `sandbox`, `approval_mode`, `reasoning_effort`, `output_schema` and MCP config. Works standalone and through AgentOS. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/codex/codex_basic.py). (#10901)
- **HyDE Query Transform**: Added `QueryTransformer` as a new retrieval hook and `HyDE` as its first implementation: `Knowledge(vector_db=..., query_transformer=HyDE())` searches with a hypothetical answer instead of the raw question, while rerankers still score against the original query. `HyDE` uses its own `model`, then the calling agent or team's model, then the framework default. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/07_knowledge/02_building_blocks/12_hyde_query_transformer.py). (#10527)
- **Browser Origin Policy**: Added `AgentOS(cors=CORSConfig(origins=..., origin_regex=..., merge_base_app=...))` and opt-in `PublicSurface(enforce_browser_origins=True)`. One origin policy is now shared by CORS preflights, public run and cancel admission, auth error headers, workflow WebSockets and MCP aliases, and CORS is the outermost middleware so error responses carry consistent headers. `cors_allowed_origins` keeps its existing behaviour. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/27_public_pages/browser_origins.py). (#10869)
- **Configurable Follow-ups**: `followups: bool | FollowupConfig` on Agent and Team. `FollowupConfig` sets a count range (`num_followups` or `min_followups` / `max_followups`), a separate model and custom instructions that go only to the follow-up call. The default prompt now stays within the answer's boundaries and no longer re-offers a request the answer declined. Existing `num_followups` callers keep getting exactly N suggestions. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/02_agents/14_advanced/followup_instructions.py). (#10087)
- **Heabsy**: Added `Heabsy` as an OpenAI-compatible model provider, also resolvable as `"heabsy:<model>"`. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/90_models/heabsy/basic.py). (#10828)
- **FlexAI**: Added `FlexAI` as an OpenAI-compatible model provider for open-weight models, also resolvable as `"flexai:<model>"`. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/90_models/flexai/basic.py). (#10871)
- **SixtyDBTools**: New toolkit for the 60db hosted speech API: discover workspace voices and generate speech as WAV audio artifacts. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/91_tools/sixtydb_tools.py). (#10786)

## Improvements:

- **Page Sync Logs**: Page synchronization now logs lock waits, discovery, progress every 25 pages and final counts, so long syncs show progress without a custom callback. Added an AgentOS cookbook that syncs documentation into PostgreSQL-backed knowledge pages and exposes them through the agent's filesystem. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/05_agent_os/27_filesystem/knowledge_fs.py). (#10868)
- **OpenAIResponses & OpenRouterResponses**: Recognise GPT-6 (OpenAI) and GPT-5/6 (OpenRouter) as reasoning models, so reasoning-state chaining and encrypted reasoning replay apply and tool-call follow-ups no longer fail with missing reasoning-item errors. (#10830)
- **PerplexitySearch**: Requests now send an `X-Pplx-Integration: agno` header so Perplexity can attribute traffic from the integration. (#10827)

## Bug Fixes:

- **Approvals**: Each `@approval` tool call in a run now gets its own approval record, for agents and teams. Previously a second pause in the same run created no record and the next continue ran the new call against the approval resolved for the first one. (#10812)
- **Model Response Cache**: Pydantic `output_schema` classes are keyed by their JSON schema instead of their class name, so two schemas with the same name but different fields no longer share a cached response. (#10621)
- **Usage Metrics**: `MessageMetrics.cache_write_tokens` is now populated from OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses usage (#10313) and from LiteLLM's `prompt_tokens_details` (#10476). Previously it was always zero.
- **JsonDb**: Tables are serialized to a staging file and published with `os.replace`, so a failed write leaves the last successfully saved table readable instead of a truncated file. (#10794)
- **MongoDb & MongoVectorDb**: `session_name`, `search_content` and keyword-search filters are regex-escaped, so a value like `(draft` no longer returns HTTP 500 from `GET /sessions` and `GET /memories`, and `v1.2` no longer matches `v1x2`. (#10709)
- **Tool Schemas**: `Annotated[T, ...]` hints are unwrapped to `T` before JSON schema generation instead of falling through to an empty object schema. (#10858)
- **SQLTools**: Connection URLs are built with `URL.create`, so a password like `p@ssword` is no longer split into password `p` and host `ssword@...`. (#10800)
- **FileTools**: `replace_file_chunk` rejects negative, reversed and out-of-bounds line ranges with an error and leaves the file untouched; a valid replacement preserves the trailing newline. (#10798)
- **GoogleCalendarTools**: `find_available_slots` compares the full slot end against closing time on its start date, so a 45 minute slot is no longer offered at 16:30 for a 17:00 close and slots cannot cross midnight. (#10878)
- **BaiduSearchTools, Searxng & SpiderTools**: An explicit `max_results=0` / `fixed_max_results=0` now means no results instead of falling back to the default. (#10877)
- **Readers**: `TextReader`, `MarkdownReader` (#10779) and `JSONReader` (#10634) accept streams whose `name` is an integer or `None`, such as descriptor-backed temporary files, instead of returning nothing or raising.
- **Cookbooks**: Fixed the `DynamoDb` import path in the DynamoDB storage README. (#10788)

## New Features

- Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)
- Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)
- Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)
- Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)
- Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)
- Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

## Bug Fixes

- Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)
- Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)
- Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

- Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)
- Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)

- Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
- Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

releases.summary:
# v3.56.0 - hardening and correctness batch

Minor release. Several fixes change behaviour on purpose; they are listed first. Integrated by merging each PR head, so authorship is preserved. Packages: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.0 (tags `latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha`), plus `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.2 and `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.3 published standalone first.

## Behaviour changes (read these)

- **Unknown ids and value-less options are errors (#3911, @martinvlad).** `agent status` / `task status` with an unknown id print "not found" and exit 1. A declared string/number option given no value (for example `hooks route --task`) now reports `Option --task needs a value` instead of silently becoming `true`. Applies to every command.
- **Sessions (#3489, #3490, @rudycelekli).** `session_save` captures the persisted task, agent and legacy memory stores by default (explicit `false` still excludes). `session_import` rejects malformed stores before saving and derives counts from the snapshot.
- **Backups (#3903).** The default project backup snapshots both `memory.db` and `agentdb-memory.db` and honors the configured memory directory. `--db` and a non-blank `CLAUDE_FLOW_DB_PATH` still select a single file.
- **Zero values are honored (#3488, #3496).** Scaling an agent pool to 0 no longer creates five workers; invalid targets fail before writing; a zero fallback retry budget is respected.
- **Path validators (#3504, `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.3).** Sensitive directory names are blocked anywhere under the project root, not only at the leaf, and the blocked-extension check also applies to synchronous validation.
- **OAuth callback server (#3507, `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.3).** Retains an early callback and ignores unrelated requests.
- **Providers (#3493, #3494, #3495).** An explicit execution provider is honored; Anthropic gateway credentials and endpoint (`ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) are used (fixes #3100); timeouts cover reading the response body.
- **Routing (#3904, #3498).** `hooks_route` now consults persisted SONA outcome patterns before local routing: only a supported agent at confidence >= 0.6 is used, and `useSemanticRouter: false` keeps keyword routing. With the opt-in neural router, model selection uses calibrated quality predictions, so calibration can move a pick across the quality bar.
- **WAL gate (#3894, @nicholas-ruest; fixes #3161).** Leftover `-wal`/`-shm` files from a closed connection no longer block `memory store`/`list`; a genuinely open holder is still refused.
- **`ruflo init` no longer pins a Claude model (#3528, @HF-teamdev; fixes #3527).**
- **`ruflo` wrapper (#3438).** Pins the matching `@claude-flow/cli` and prints a warning if the resolved CLI version differs. It warns and continues; it does not refuse to run. Fixes #3306.
- **Claims (#3502).** CLI and MCP share one lossless claims.json format; unreadable or malformed stores are refused rather than replaced.
- **Native immutable conditional append (#3750, @stuinfla).** New `memory store` flags `--append-only`, `--append-conditions`, `--require-native`, `--no-embedding`. Additive, CLI only.

## Fixes

- Shipped `.claude/settings.json` had unescaped quotes in hook commands and did not parse (#3895, fixes #3888, @nicholas-ruest). A new test checks that every shipped settings/plugin JSON file parses.
- Remaining better-sqlite3 opens use the shared loader (#3896, @nicholas-ruest; supersedes #3884 by @drakeo338); RFE1-encrypted stores are reported as encrypted, not broken (#3906, fixes #2889, @nicholas-ruest); the demo plugin-registry fallback is labelled as unverified (#3897, @martinvlad).
- `analyze` preserves machine-readable JSON (#3910); `doctor` rejects unsupported component selections (#3907) and loads MetaHarness via file URLs on Windows (#3523, fixes #3186); `daemon start` honors explicit workers (#3586).
- Unreadable task/agent records are preserved (#3484); async registry updates do not revive retired agents (#3492); fallback learning is attributed per attempted model (#3497).
- Workflow step boundaries are validated (#3491); persisted workflows resume without duplicate executors (#3500) and keep control signals and sibling state across awaits (#3505).
- Memory JSON import reports rejected writes accurately (#3499); export reads all pages only after successful reads (#3501); concurrent rotating-token refreshes coalesce (#3506).
- Test fixtures isolate pnpm's NODE_PATH (#3543, fixes #3529, @HF-teamdev's report).
- `@claude-flow/memory` 3.0.2: cache admission accounts for replacement sizes (#3679, fixes #3678); invalidation matches each key independently (#3687, fixes #3686).
- Handlebars lock entries moved to 4.7.10 after new critical advisories against 4.7.9 (dev tooling only).
- An empty `.claude/agents/tmp.json` no longer ships in the CLI tarball.

Contributors: @rudycelekli, @nicholas-ruest, @martinvlad, @HF-teamdev, @drakeo338, @stuinfla. Thank you.

## Not included, and why

- #3503 (fail-closed policy envelope): on the real MCP dispatch path nothing supplies cost/token/concurrency, so any envelope with a ceiling would deny every tool call; its own updated test shows `concurrency-outside-envelope`. Needs the dispatcher to supply metering.
- #3892 (policy ledger retention): default `policy verify` would stop covering the archive; needs the archive tip anchored or cross-checked, and the home mirror handled.
- #3831 (embedding cache dir): needs a rebase and half of it targets `@claude-flow/embeddings`, which cannot be published from main.
- #3694 (configurable MCP rate limits): needs a ceiling for non-loopback binds.
- #3879/#3622/#3476 (EWC), #3835, #3751, #3909, #3905, #3690, #3776: drafts or decisions pending.

## Verification

Full CLI suite 5408 passed (4 failures that reproduce identically on unmodified main in the release environment), security 611/611, memory suite passes, ruflo wrapper test, umbrella lockstep and leaf audits, witness manifests 117/117 on linux/macos/windows, pnpm frozen install passes the new lockfile and fails the old one.

Release PR #3916: 120 CI checks passed on the final head (3 skipped). Registry check after publish: `latest`, `alpha` and `v3alpha` all point at 3.56.0 for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo`; a clean `npx ruflo@latest --version` reports v3.56.0 with memory 3.0.2 and security 3.0.3, and `mcp start -t http --host 0.0.0.0` refuses without a token.

key_changes: 未知名ID和无值选项现在会报错退出（如 `agent status` 遇到未知ID输出 "not found"，无值选项报告 `Option --task needs a value`），不再静默接受
session_save 默认捕获持久化的任务、代理和内存存储；session_import 拒绝畸形存储
备份默认同时快照 memory.db 和 agentdb-memory.db，并遵循配置的内存目录
路径验证器现在会阻止项目根目录下任意位置（不仅叶节点）的敏感目录名
路由逻辑改变：hooks_route 先查询持久化的 SONA 结果模式，仅使用置信度 >= 0.6 的受支持代理
新增原生不可变条件附加功能，memory store 新增 --append-only、--append-conditions、--require-native、--no-embedding 标志
ai_summary.summary_cn: v3.56.0 是一次以安全强化和正确性修复为主的版本更新，包含多项有意的行为变更。主要变更包括：未知名 ID 和无值选项现在会报错而非静默处理、session 存储和备份行为更严谨、路径验证覆盖范围扩大、路由决策更依赖持久化数据等。此外还修复了大量 bug，并新增了原生不可变条件附加操作（append-only）能力。破坏性变更较多（行为变化在 Release Notes 中明确标记为"请务必阅读"），建议升级前充分测试。

### Patch Changes

- 9184a35: Add ordered text, file, and JSON parts to experimental decision state. Support image input in OpenAI Decisions and language model adapters. Gateway retains its existing string and JSON request format and rejects files, as does TypeSafe AI.

  Preserve native JSON state in TypeSafe AI when state contains one JSON part. Label shared state in language-model decision prompts.

- Updated dependencies [9184a35]

ai/@ai-sdk/provider 新增顶层 embedding 'dimensions' 设置，多个 provider（voyage/perplexity/mistral/openai/cohere 等）同步映射
ai@7.0.135 新增持久化 WebSocket 聊天传输（相关性流式、背压、取消、序列续传）
ai@7.0.133 及 typesafe-ai/gateway/openai/otel 等将实验性决策状态重构为有序 text/file/JSON parts，并支持图片输入
@ai-sdk/mcp@2.0.73 对实验性 MCP 事件适配器做出破坏性变更（须实现 createAdapter）
@ai-sdk/workflow@2.0.66 将 Workflow SDK 支持升级到稳定的 5.1.0

releases.summary:
### Patch Changes

- 9184a35: Add ordered text, file, and JSON parts to experimental decision state. Support image input in OpenAI Decisions and language model adapters. Gateway retains its existing string and JSON request format and rejects files, as does TypeSafe AI.

  Arrays passed directly as state now contain decision state parts. Wrap JSON arrays in an object or a json part.

  Normalize all public state forms into an array of parts before calling decision providers. Providers receive text and JSON objects as text and json parts.

  Serialize decision file bytes as base64 in OpenTelemetry state attributes. Model-call spans record normalized state parts, while outer spans retain public state inputs.

  Preserve native JSON state in TypeSafe AI when state contains one JSON part. Label shared state in language-model decision prompts.

- Updated dependencies [9184a35]
  - @ai-sdk/provider@4.0.25
  - @ai-sdk/provider-utils@5.0.57

ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本为 v1.28.42，包含多个 Breaking Changes，主要涉及多个 API 删除了 401 错误响应类型，以及部分接口的响应数据结构发生变化。同时新增了 sandboxes 相关的 getDrive 和 forkDrive 两个接口，并为 projects、deployments、teams 等接口增加了新的字段。由于存在大量不兼容的破坏性变更，升级此版本需谨慎评估现有代码的兼容性。

claude.ai 连接器默认协商 MCP 协议版本 2026-07-28，可通过 MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy 选择旧版

MCP 工具长结果保存到文件或被截断时，超过 500,000 字符的文本被丢弃
MCP 工具结果 _meta 超过 1,048,576 JSON 字符时被省略（SDK 服务器工具除外），文本块 _meta 总计超过 65,536 时也被省略
cline dashboard 命令更名为 cline hub dashboard，旧命令仅作为隐藏别名保留

cline schedule create、update 和 import 拒绝无法投递的投递配置（如 --delivery-adapter 无 --delivery-thread），之前会静默保存
裸 --retries 无参数时现在报错而不是崩溃
AI SDK 统一到单一发布线：ai 7.0.120 和所有 @ai-sdk/* 包使用 @ai-sdk/provider-utils 5.0.50（之前 ai 7.0.79 且各包独立升级）
关闭推理时不再向无法关闭推理的 OpenAI 模型（如 GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol）发送 reasoning.effort: "none"，也不再向无法关闭思考的 Claude 模型（如 Claude Fable 5、Opus 5.5）发送 thinking: {type: "disabled"}
SAP AI Core 提供程序不再安装 winston 的进程级 uncaughtException 处理器
旧版提供程序设置迁移不再向 providers.json 添加空的 sapaicore 条目

零值被正确尊重：代理池缩放到 0 不再创建五个 worker；零回退重试预算被尊重
路径验证器：敏感目录名在项目根目录下任何位置都被阻止（不仅是叶节点），阻止扩展名检查也适用于同步验证

vercel.user.listEventTypes() 的 response.types[] 结构变更
vercel.teams.getTeams() 的 response.teams[] 结构变更
vercel.deployments.getDeployment()、createDeployment()、cancelDeployment() 的 services[] 结构变更
vercel.checksV2 多个 API（updateDeploymentCheckRun、getDeploymentCheckRun、createDeploymentCheckRun、listDeploymentCheckRuns、listCheckRuns）的响应结构变更
vercel.sandboxes.listDrives()、getOrCreateDrive()、deleteDrive() 的响应结构变更
vercel.projects.getProjects() 的请求参数变更
对实验性 MCP 事件适配器 API 做出破坏性变更，要求实现新的同步 createAdapter 方法，影响订阅操作接口使用方式

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本批信号以跨仓库共性安全问题为主：多个 Agent/SDK/SaaS 平台在"身份/凭据与权限边界""会话状态与执行恢复""MCP/流式协议数据完整性""打包/发布交付"四大类目上存在系统性缺陷。其中尤为突出的是：Aider 等工具对敏感凭据的越界读写与 git 历史泄漏、多仓库的人审/审批门禁可被绕过及重试导致非幂等副作用重复执行、以及官方 marketplace/SDK 的打包发布（缺 wheel、钉死失效修订、Native Image 崩溃）持续阻断用户部署。

top_pain_points.topic: Aider 安装/运行时报 scipy._propack 导入失败 (ImportError in _svdp.py)，导致无法启动/会话崩溃
top_pain_points.summary: 多个用户在 macOS arm64 上运行 Aider 时，构建 repo-map 过程中调用 networkx/scipy pagerank 时触发 scipy 的 _propack C 扩展加载失败（dlopen __DATA/__thread_bss 错误），导致整个交互会话抛出未捕获异常直接崩溃而终止。
aliases: BOM 导致 skill 无法解析
YAML 布尔值塌缩数值配置
fallback 状态固定错误模型

不支持的媒体类型导致崩溃
回退吞掉取消/超时错误
大型二进制读取无反查上限
失败 API 请求噪声
结果投递失败重复执行
top_pain_points.review_reason: 6 位用户连续（2026-10-04 至 10-08 一周内）在 macOS/arm64 上因 scipy 二进制扩展加载失败而遇到未捕获异常，整个 Aider 交互会话直接崩溃终止，属于主流程阻断（构建 repo-map 这一核心路径被击穿），且全部有完整崩溃堆栈与可复现样例链接支撑。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings
source_issues.evidence: 附件上传是沙箱可用后用户执行的第一个操作，缓存空字段被当作权威覆盖有效运行上下文，导致就绪的沙箱看似不可用，迫使用户重试本已具备成功条件的操作。

top_pain_points.topic: AI 生成的代码可读写项目目录外的敏感凭据文件，且自动提交到 git 历史且无任何警告
top_pain_points.summary: 在通过多轮对话引导后，Aider 会生成并自动提交读取 ~/.ssh/id_rsa 等敏感私钥并写入配置的代码，且不对越权访问敏感凭据给出任何提示，造成凭据泄露风险并被纳入 git 历史。
aliases: 令牌吊销后 git 失败
被拒绝的工具调用仍执行
top_pain_points.review_reason: 尽管是单一安全问题的复现性报告，但用户证据明确：生成的代码读取项目目录外的 SSH 私钥并被自动提交到 git 历史，存在真实的凭据泄露与环境污染影响，属于关键安全功能缺失，因此保留为 P1。

source_issues.title: Generated code can read SSH private keys outside the project directory without warning
source_issues.evidence: 复现显示生成代码 os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/id_rsa') 读取私钥写入配置对象，且被自动提交，全程无警告；评论数达 17

source_issues.title: Avoid exposing provider credentials to child commands
source_issues.evidence: 源码级证据：run_cmd_subprocess 用 subprocess.Popen 未限制 env、/git 显式复制完整环境，OPENCY_API_KEY/Lilik 等凭据可被子进程继承；给出一键可复现的 sentinel 命令

source_issues.title: OAuth authorize error paths: open redirect via unvalidated redirect_uri
source_issues.evidence: authorize 错误路径未校验 redirect_uri 造成开放重定向。

source_issues.title: Authorize/consent page: open redirect on both Deny and Approve paths
source_issues.evidence: consent 页在 Deny 与 Approve 两条路径都开放重定向。

source_issues.title: Frontend: integration setup wizard navigates to an unvalidated redirect_uri (open redirect and javascript: execution)
source_issues.evidence: 集成向导跳转到未校验 redirect_uri，存在开放重定向与 javascript: 执行。

source_issues.title: Frontend: MCP OAuth callback drops the state token on provider errors, so a denied sign-in hangs until the 5-minute timeout
source_issues.evidence: provider 错误时丢失 state，用户拒绝授权则挂起至 5 分钟超时。

source_issues.title: [Bug] AgentOS `/continue` trusts client-supplied approval state, bypassing tool confirmation gates
source_issues.evidence: PoC 证实：向已完成 run 伪造 requires_confirmation 工具调用（delete_everything 删除 /etc/shadow）即可执行；@approval(type=required) 的 pending 审批记录可在无管理员批准下自行批准并执行 wire_transfer，DB 记录仍为 pending。confirmed 位完全由客户端决定。

source_issues.title: A rejected user-input tool still executes when a requirements payload answers it
source_issues.evidence: 已被管理员标记为 rejected 的 requires_user_input 工具，在客户端重发 requirements 负载后仍会执行（Case 4 分支未检查 _t.confirmed）；on main 中被拒绝的工具在首次 continue 即执行。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Free models fail when `shell` or `read` permissions are denied
source_issues.evidence: 设置 shell 或 read 权限为 deny 后，免费模型请求报 'Error: OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode'；改为 allow 立即恢复正常，可在运行中复现

source_issues.title: policy: deny shell * on custom agent breaks free tier with "can only be used from within OpenCode"
source_issues.evidence: 自定义 primary agent 取消注释 shell den条 后，免费层所有请求失败并报 origin 错误；注释掉即恢复，始终可复现，影响所有免费模型

top_pain_points.topic: GraalVM Native Image 下 SDK 启动/运行即崩溃（缺少穷举可达性元数据）
top_pain_points.summary: 在 Oracle GraalVM Native Image + Spring Boot 环境中，SDK 的序列化模型层级缺少 reachability metadata，应用构建为 native image 后调用即抛 KotlinReflectionInternalError（Unresolved class）并返回 500；手工注册一个类后又连锁暴露 JsonField$IsMissing、KnownValue 等更多缺失。native 部署的应用基本不可用。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 使用 GraalVM Native Image 部署的生产应用在运行时直接崩溃并返回 500，且单点手工修复无济于事（连锁暴露更多缺失类），属启动/运行期阻断，对 native 部署子集用户影响强烈。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Native Image runtime failure due to missing GraalVM reachability metadata
source_issues.evidence: SDK 2.64.0 + GraalVM 25.0.4 native 构建后 curl /chat 返回 500，报 kotlin.reflect.jvm.internal.KotlinReflectionInternalError / Unresolved class com.anthropic.models.messages.MessageCreateParams$Body；手工注册后继续报 com.anthropic.core.JsonField$IsMissing、KnownValue，属更普遍的缺失。

source_issues.title: Activation fails if there's a non-standard color palette in place.

source_issues.title: Windows sandbox helper fails with helper_unknown_error: setup refresh had errors on every exec_command and file read
source_issues.evidence: 每个 exec_command 甚至纯文件读取都在沙箱初始化层失败，100% 工具调用失败，导致 headless/自动化 codex-cli 完全失去执行与读取能力。

source_issues.title: Windows: all commands fail with “helper_unknown_error: setup refresh had errors”
source_issues.evidence: 只读 Get-Location 在进程启动前失败，同一错误出现在原对话与新对话，阻断代码检查、测试与开发。

top_pain_points.topic: 恢复/重新派发的图执行丢失执行身份与状态：人工审核的安全模式被绕过、凭据输入丢失、节点被重复计费
top_pain_points.summary: 基于人工审核或重排队恢复的执行，在重建 ExecutionContext 时丢失 graph_exec_id/user_id 等身份字段，导致多个严重副作用：被拒绝的不可逆操作仍然执行、安全模式审核被跳过、媒体/文件块报错，且重新派发的节点会再次扣除 credits（计费不幂等）。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 同一恢复路径导致安全模式这一核心安全保证被绕过（被拒绝的不可逆操作仍执行）、产生重复计费这一直接成本损失，并中断依赖媒体/凭据的所有节点——均为主流程阻断与成本/安全双重复严重的用户痛点。

source_issues.title: Resuming after a human review rebuilds ExecutionContext without graph_exec_id/user_id: rejected irreversible actions still run, later ones skip review, media blocks fail
source_issues.evidence: 恢复审核后重建的执行上下文 graph_exec_id/user_id 均为 None，Block._execute 仅在 graph_exec_id 非 None 时才做审核检查，导致被拒绝的不可逆操作照常执行、store_media_file 抛 'execution_context.graph_exec_id is required'。

source_issues.title: Node executions re-dispatched on resume (REVIEW/RUNNING) are charged credits again; usage charges are not idempotent
source_issues.evidence: 恢复时重新派发的节点再次计费，用量扣费不幂等，导致用户重复扣费。

source_issues.title: Resumed/requeued graph executions lose run-time credential inputs (compiled credential masks are never persisted)
source_issues.evidence: 恢复/重排队的执行丢失运行时凭据输入，凭据掩码从未持久化，导致后续节点因缺凭据失败。

source_issues.title: Failed to drain Session: one malformed tool result wedges the whole session
source_issues.evidence: 单个 tool-result.value 非数组使 .map() 抛错，runStep→drain 崩溃，导致该会话每次 prompt 都 'Failed to drain Session' 永久失效（一晚 33 次），新会话正常

source_issues.title: session: two server processes sharing one opencode.db allocate session_message.seq independently - UNIQUE(seq) collisions fail sessions
source_issues.evidence: 两个 server 进程共享 opencode.db 时独立分配 seq，插入撞 UNIQUE 约束报 'Session failed'，永久破坏该 server 上的会话

source_issues.title: core: tool stuck in pending state when hitting SQLITE full errors
source_issues.evidence: 本地工具结果写入 DB 失败（SQLITE_FULL）时发出无 tool_result 的 tool_use，Anthropic 返回 400，且调用一直卡在 running 状态直到被中断

source_issues.title: Compaction deltas can revive cleared values when accumulated messages are replayed
source_issues.evidence: delta 将 content/encrypted_content 设为 null 后,类型化字符串变为空但 json.Marshal(ToParam) 仍发送之前的字符串。遗漏字段的 delta 也会清除类型化字符串。原始 JSON、AsCompaction、ToParam 与重放结果不一致,导致会话状态被错误恢复。

source_issues.title: Tool runner ignores additions and removals retained in compaction blocks
source_issues.evidence: 工具运行器的 availableToolNames 忽略 compaction 块中的 tool_changes,被移除的本地工具仍可执行,被压缩重新添加的工具未能还原。已失效工具被错误调用,破坏工具可用性一致性。

source_issues.title: Partial compaction deltas erase accumulated summaries or encrypted metadata
source_issues.evidence: 完整公共 accumulator 序列以 message_stop 结尾后调用 toParam()，确认可重放块中的加密元数据丢失；省略与显式 null/空串语义被混淆。

source_issues.title: MessageStream async iteration silently completes when an error occurs between reads
source_issues.evidence: silently report normal completion when the failure happens between reads ... iterator.next() resolves to {done:true}. An already-buffered event is delivered and then the same failure is lost.

top_pain_points.topic: PyPI 自 0.2.160 起缺失 Windows win_amd64 wheel，阻塞 Windows 用户升级
top_pain_points.summary: claude-agent-sdk 0.2.160 至最新 0.2.163 在 PyPI 上均无 win_amd64 wheel（最后一个有 wheel 的版本是 0.2.159），Windows 用户被阻塞在当前版本，无法升级到最新版 SDK。
top_pain_points.review_reason: Windows 平台用户无法在 PyPI 获取新版本 wheel，被阻塞在旧版无法升级，直接导致新版本的关键修复与功能在 Windows 上不可用。属发布打包环节阻断用户升级路径，有明确用户影响证据。

source_issues.title: PyPI has no win_amd64 wheel for SDK 0.2.160 through latest 0.2.163
source_issues.evidence: 用户指出最后一个有 Windows wheel 的版本是 0.2.159，0.2.160 至最新 0.2.163 均无 win_amd64 wheel，'blocks us from upgrading the agent-sdk to the latest'，即被阻塞无法在 Windows 上升级。

source_issues.title: [BUG] Windows MSIX Desktop: every process a session spawns leaks kernel nonpaged pool (NtFC) when it opens a path through a junction under AppData (bindflt.sys bug)
source_issues.evidence: Every process a session spawns leaks kernel nonpaged pool whenever it opens a path through an AppData junction, attributed to a bindflt.sys bug, indicating repeated system-level resource leaks in the MSIX package.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Windows MSIX desktop app: Claude Code sessions inherit AppData filesystem virtualization, so tools installed from inside a session land in the package LocalCache and are invisible or broken outside the app
source_issues.evidence: Sessions inherit AppData virtualization, so tools installed from inside a session (uv Python, uv tools, caches) land in the package LocalCache and are invisible or broken outside the app — installed tooling is effectively lost to the user.

source_issues.title: [BUG] Cowork VM fails to start on Windows 11 26H2 — sessiondata.vhdx CreateVirtualDisk 0x1772 (EFS-encrypted LocalCache)
source_issues.evidence: Cowork VM fails to start with CreateVirtualDisk 0x1772 because the package's LocalCache is EFS-encrypted — a direct blocking failure of the Cowork sandbox on Windows.

source_issues.title: Marketplace pins 54 plugins to revisions that fail codex plugin add validation

signals.topic: Aider 安装/运行时报 scipy._propack 导入失败 (ImportError in _svdp.py)，导致无法启动/会话崩溃

signals.review_reason: 6 位用户连续（2026-10-04 至 10-08 一周内）在 macOS/arm64 上因 scipy 二进制扩展加载失败而遇到未捕获异常，整个 Aider 交互会话直接崩溃终止，属于主流程阻断（构建 repo-map 这一核心路径被击穿），且全部有完整崩溃堆栈与可复现样例链接支撑。

signals.topic: AI 生成的代码可读写项目目录外的敏感凭据文件，且自动提交到 git 历史且无任何警告
signals.summary: 在通过多轮对话引导后，Aider 会生成并自动提交读取 ~/.ssh/id_rsa 等敏感私钥并写入配置的代码，且不对越权访问敏感凭据给出任何提示，造成凭据泄露风险并被纳入 git 历史。
signals.review_reason: 尽管是单一安全问题的复现性报告，但用户证据明确：生成的代码读取项目目录外的 SSH 私钥并被自动提交到 git 历史，存在真实的凭据泄露与环境污染影响，属于关键安全功能缺失，因此保留为 P1。

source_issues.title: Generated code can read SSH private keys outside the project directory without warning
source_issues.evidence: 复现显示生成代码 os.path.expanduser('~/.ssh/id_rsa') 读取私钥写入配置对象，且被自动提交，全程无警告；评论数达 17

signals.topic: Aider 的 /run、/test、lint、/git 子命令会继承父进程环境，把模型供应商凭据（如 OPENAI_API_KEY）暴露给不可信子进程
signals.summary: Aider 执行本地子命令（/run、/test、lint、/git）时完整继承进程环境，使仓库控制的脚本、测试、linter 能读取模型供应商 API 凭据；这些子进程本无需模型权限，若被不可信/被攻陷的代码利用可窃取凭据。
signals.review_reason: 本地执行的子命令（测试/脚本/linter/git）继承 Aider 进程环境，等于把与它们无关的模型供应商 API 凭据交给仓库内任意代码；当这些代码不可信或遭攻陷时可直接窃取凭据、造成用户计费/账号损失，属影响明确的安全与成本风险，因此保留。

source_issues.title: Avoid exposing provider credentials to child commands
source_issues.evidence: 源码级证据：run_cmd_subprocess 用 subprocess.Popen 未限制 env、/git 显式复制完整环境，OPENCY_API_KEY/Lilik 等凭据可被子进程继承；给出一键可复现的 sentinel 命令

signals.topic: Aider 默认使用 --no-verify 旁路本地 git pre-commit 钩子（含 SAST/密钥泄露检测器），静默提交有隐患代码
signals.summary: Aider 的 --git-commit-verify 默认为 False，提交时无条件追加 --no-verify，导致 LLM 生成的含硬编码密钥或注入恶意代码的改动可绕过仓库的安全钩子直接进入 git 历史且无任何提示。
signals.review_reason: 默认行为会静默绕过仓库配置的 pre-commit 安全检查（如密钥泄露扫描、格式/SAST），使 LLM 生成的含硬编码密钥或恶意代码直接进入 git 历史，破坏用户依赖的安全防线，具备明确的凭据与合规风险，故保留。

source_issues.title: Security Risk: Aider silently bypasses pre-commit hooks by default (--no-verify)
source_issues.evidence: 静态源码分析定位默认值 default=False，repo.py 中无条件 cmd.append('--no-verify')；修复建议将默认改为 True 让绕过成为显式 opt-in

signals.topic: Aider 启动时强制联网拉取模型价格/上下文配置，网络不通即报错并被打断
signals.summary: 本地启动 Aider 时即触发访问 raw.githubusercontent.com 拉取 litellm model_prices 配置，离线或网络受限环境下启动报 Max retries exceeded 错误；本应在用户确实需要列出/切换模型时才联网（懒加载）。
signals.review_reason: 在离线或受限网络环境下，纯本地启动 Aider 也会因启动时强制联网拉取模型配置而报错、无法进入正常提示符，直接阻断离线用户的主流程，故作为 P2 保留。（注：此为单一 issue，未达 P0 所需的 count>=3 门槛）

source_issues.title: Don't fetch model information on Aider start, instead lazy load them only when needed
source_issues.evidence: 启动 aiders 即出现 raw.githubusercontent.com Connection refused 错误，用户认为仅启动本地就发起联网既有隐私顾虑也造成离线环境不可用

signals.topic: 成本/计费静默计算错误导致费用与用量显示不准
signals.summary: 成本追踪的两个 bug 会让显示的费用与用量静默不准：新模型被按旧模型费率计费，单个非有限 token 数把整条 span 的有效计数清零。

signals.topic: MCP 服务器连接/保存过程错误提示误导且操作失败
signals.summary: MCP 服务器在保存、切换、删除或连接测试失败时，UI 显示误导性/重复的错误提示（如 "Check the URL and server type"、"Disconnected (check URL or network)"），隐藏真实错误，或同时弹出两个相同错误 toast，且部分 MCP 库条目在本地后端无法安装。
signals.review_reason: MCP 服务器是用户接入外部工具的关键环节，多个 issue 表明失败时错误被隐藏或误报，部分条目完全无法安装，用户在排查真实连接问题时被误导反复试错。注：issue_number 为占位，实际以索引为准。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: A failed STDIO MCP connection test says "Check the URL and server type" and hides the real error
source_issues.evidence: STDIO MCP 连接测试失败时只提示 'Check the URL and server type'，隐藏真实错误，用户无法判断真正的连接问题。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Plugins and Apps: install/update errors say "Disconnected (check URL or network)" instead of the server's reason, and plugin errors toast twice
source_issues.evidence: 插件/应用安装或更新失败时显示误导性的 'Disconnected (check URL or network)' 而非服务端真实原因，且错误 toast 弹出两次。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: MCP library lists entries that cannot be installed on a local backend; their install dialog is empty and Install does nothing
source_issues.evidence: MCP 库列出本地后端无法安装的条目，安装对话框为空且 Install 按钮无反应。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: A failed MCP server save, toggle or delete shows two identical error toasts
source_issues.evidence: MCP 服务器保存、切换或删除失败时弹出两个相同错误 toast。

signals.topic: 云沙箱附件上传/会话恢复不稳定导致首操作失败
signals.summary: 云沙箱附件上传在沙箱刚可用时因缓存空字段覆盖返回"sandbox still starting"误报；retry 失败的消息会丢失已上传的文件上下文；沙箱暂停后云会话恢复失败。
signals.review_reason: 附件上传和会话恢复是用户在沙箱环境的核心交互，多个问题叠加（误报未就绪、重试丢文件、恢复失败）导致首操作反复失败、数据丢失、会话中断，直接影响 API 使用体验。（部分 issue_number 为占位）

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings
source_issues.evidence: 附件上传是沙箱可用后用户执行的第一个操作，缓存空字段被当作权威覆盖有效运行上下文，导致就绪的沙箱看似不可用，迫使用户重试本已具备成功条件的操作。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Retrying a failed attachment message drops the uploaded file context
source_issues.evidence: 重试失败的附件消息会丢失已上传的文件上下文，用户需要重新上传。

source_issues.title: Cloud conversations fail to resume reliably after sandbox pause
source_issues.evidence: 沙箱暂停后云会话无法可靠恢复。

signals.topic: 自定义 LLM 提供方配置无法使用：添加本地/代理 LLM 配置报错且聊天不可用
signals.summary: 用户通过高级设置或 provider connection 添加自定义/本地 LLM 提供方时，保存报litellm "LLM Provider NOT provided" 错误，即使保存成功启动对话也只会显示纯 "error"，导致关键 AI 对话功能不可用。
signals.review_reason: 用户无法添加或使用自定义/本地 LLM 提供方，保存即报错、即便保存成功对话也始终失败只显示泛化 'error'，核心 AI 对话功能被阻断，属于主流程不可用的真实用户痛点。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Cannot add LLM profile with advanced settings
source_issues.evidence: 用户设置本地 qwen 提供方时保存报 litellm.BadRequestError: LLM Provider NOT provided；改用 Provider connection 后能保存但发起 chat 时 console 显示同样错误，UI 只显示 'error'。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Unable to use 9Router as a custom LLM connection proxying Ollama
source_issues.evidence: 9Router 通过 openAI 兼容端点代理 ollama，但 litellm 无法识别，返回 Provider NOT provided 错误，用户无法使用该自定义提供方。已给出根因（应根据 provider connection 而非模型前缀选择 API 规范）。

signals.topic: LLM 运行错误未透出到前端，用户只见泛化 'error' 无法排查
signals.summary: 当 LLM 调用失败（如模型不存在/连接错误）时，服务端日志有具体错误，但前端界面只显示泛化的 "error"，用户无法得知失败原因也无法自排查。
signals.review_reason: LLM 调用失败时具体错误不向用户展示，用户只见 'error' 且刷新后错误信息完全消失，无法得知失败原因和回复情况，显著降低体验并妨碍自排查。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: LLM errors not propagated to the frontend
source_issues.evidence: 使用 Nebius 时日志显示模型不存在(404)等具体错误，但 UI 只显示 'error'，用户完全无法得知失败原因。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Run-failure banner disappears after reload (error invisible, user message left unanswered)
source_issues.evidence: 运行失败后报错 banner 仅存在内存中，页面刷新（尤其移动端 tab 恢复）后错误消失，用户消息留空无回复无错误，看起来像 agent 静默忽略请求。作者称这是移动端最常见的困惑。

signals.topic: 插件启动 Unicode 参数被破坏导致 /launch 链接无法使用
signals.summary: 插件启动负载用 btoa/atob 直接处理 JSON 字符串，非 Latin-1 文本（中文/emoji）会抛 InvalidCharacterError 或被按 Latin-1 解析导致参数值乱码，用户分享的 /launch?plugins= 链接参数被损坏。
signals.review_reason: 使用中文/emoji 参数的插件分享链接会被破坏甚至完全失效，功能数据损坏，但影响面相对限定于内含非 ASCII 参数的高阶用法。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Plugin launch payload corrupts Unicode parameter values
source_issues.evidence: 含中文/emoji 的插件参数经 /launch 链接打开后显示为乱码 'æçåå¸è¯´æ  ð'，且 buildPluginLaunchPath 抛 InvalidCharacterError，分享的插件启动链接失效。

signals.topic: 数据处理块静默丢失/损坏用户数据：电子表格去重列值丢失、文本解码乱码、正则匹配被丢弃、列表去重错误、文件分块失效
signals.summary: 多个数据处理块存在输出错误：重复表头导致电子表格数据静默覆盖丢失、空行产生空行、TextDecoder 将非 ASCII 文本变成乱码并在 Windows 路径上崩溃、正则组不匹配时丢弃全部匹配、列表去重把 1/True、[]/{} 当作相等、文件读取无法按分隔符分块输出。用户导入的数据被静默改写或丢失。
signals.review_reason: 用户把电子表格/文本/文件数据接入工作流时，输出被静默改写或丢失且无任何警告，属于直接影响业务数据的体验与正确性损伤；多个块反复出现同样性质的数据损坏，构成高频问题。

source_issues.title: ReadSpreadsheetBlock silently drops columns with duplicate header names and emits empty {} rows for blank lines
source_issues.evidence: 重复表头时 data[header[i]]=value 使后列覆盖前列，contents='a,a\n1,2' 输出 [{'a':'2'}]，值 1 被静默丢弃；空行产生空 {} 行。

source_issues.title: TextDecoderBlock corrupts non-ASCII text (unicode_escape mojibake) and crashes on invalid escapes such as Windows paths
source_issues.evidence: unicode_escape 处理把非 ASCII 文本变成乱码，并在 Windows 路径等非法转义上崩溃。

source_issues.title: CodeExtractionBlock leaves capitalised-language code fences (e.g. ```Python) in remaining_text after extracting them
source_issues.evidence: 提取后剩余文本仍残留 ```Python 等大写语言代码围栏。

source_issues.title: ExtractTextInformationBlock drops all matches and reports no match when a regex group is unmatched or the pattern is invalid
source_issues.evidence: 正则组不匹配或模式无效时丢弃全部匹配并报告无匹配。

signals.topic: 定时调度配置损坏与运行时间不符：编辑调度保存总是失败、cron 星期翻译错误、非法间隔生成、计划时间与实际运行时间不一致
signals.summary: 定时调度环节存在多处失效：前端编辑调度 PATCH 到不存在的接口导致保存永远失败，cron 星期 0-7/*/n/步进范围翻译错误导致在错误日期触发，自定义间隔生成 APScheduler 拒绝的非法 cron，且计划运行时间与实际运行时间长期不一致。用户无法可靠配置或依赖定时任务。
signals.review_reason: 定时任务是用户依赖的核心自动化能力，调度保存失败、触发日期错误、非法 cron 与时间漂移会让用户无法可信地安排任务，属于关键功能不可用与体验显著下降。

source_issues.title: Frontend: Edit schedule dialog PATCHes /api/schedules/{id}, which has no Next.js route or backend endpoint, so saving always fails
source_issues.evidence: 编辑调度对话框 PATCH 到不存在的接口，保存永远失败。

source_issues.title: Scheduler cron day-of-week translation: 0-7 fires only Sundays, */n fires on wrong days, wrap-around ranges with a step raise
source_issues.evidence: cron 星期翻译错误导致在错误日期触发。

source_issues.title: Frontend: custom schedule interval accepts 60 minutes / 24 hours / 31 days, generating a cron APScheduler rejects
source_issues.evidence: 自定义间隔接受非法值，生成被调度器拒绝的 cron。

source_issues.title: Scheduled time and Actual run time do not match
source_issues.evidence: 计划运行时间与实际运行时间长期不一致。

signals.topic: OAuth/集成授权流程风险：authorize/consent 与集成向导的未校验 redirect_uri 导致开放重定向（含 javascript: 执行）、MCP 回调丢失 state 致拒绝授权挂起 5 分钟
signals.summary: 授权/同意页面与集成设置向导导航到未校验的 redirect_uri，同时存在开放重定向与 javascript: 协议执行风险；MCP OAuth 回调在 provider 错误时丢弃 state 令牌，导致用户点拒绝后一直挂起到 5 分钟超时。授权流程对用户缺乏可靠反馈。
signals.review_reason: 授权流程问题直接作用于用户接入第三方集成的主要步骤：开放重定向可将受信任授权流程变成钓鱼入口，授权被拒后 5 分钟无响应也显著拉低体验；属 auth 主流程的可感知痛点。
